events.title: 500 FINGER FILLET is in Steam Next Fest!!
events.summary: HELLO GAMERS ONE AND ALL! WELCOME TO THE LAND OF STABBING!I am excited to report that 500 FINGER FILLET is going to be part of Steam Next Fest! For those of you who missed it, we updated the demo last week with a ton of new content: new knives, new rings, new items, new modifiers, new endings. And, of course, the same Ursa:We're excited to see what you think of the new demo, and we hope you enjoy the full game coming November 12th!!Have fun, Heather Flowers

events.title: 500 FINGER FILLET is coming out NOVEMBER 12TH, 2026!
events.summary: \I'm incredibly excited to report that 500 FINGER FILLET will be coming out November 12th!!!And with this announcement comes a new demo for y'all to play, OUT NOW!!!This new demo features:5 new knives (Craft Knife, Scalpel, Screwdriver, Minute Hand, Ghost Knife)2 new rings (Sprint Ring, Reflex Ring)11 new upgrades (5 positive, 6 negative)\ new endingsVarious graphics upgrades and QoL improvementsI hope you enjoy the new demo content, and that you're looking forward to the full game release!Happy

events.title: 500 FINGER FILLET Playtest Signups are live!
events.summary: HELLO ALL.If you're interested in playtesting 500 FINGER FILLET further as we expand from the demo to the full game, please consider signing up through this form! If accepted, you'll be able to download new beta builds of the game as we gear up towards launch over the next few months, and provide feedback on the changing state of the game!https://forms.gle/5UJn6QYe6cGU8QAr6HAVE FUN, Heather Flowers
